history.summary: 99-yr leasehold 1BR at Affinity At Serangoon, D19, a large recently-completed (2024) development, asking $858,888 at $1,534 PSF for an efficient 560 sqft, 950m from CR9 Serangoon North (Cross Island Line, future). Very deep 513-txn base, but resale-only appreciation is just 1.35%/yr vs a 3.46% headline.
history.rating_rationale: The 513-txn base is excellent for liquidity confidence, but the headline 3.46%/yr is inflated by launch-phase pricing — the resale-only figure is a weak 1.35%/yr, the honest signal for a 2024 project where developer pricing has worked through. At $1,534 PSF, near-term upside is limited until the CRL Serangoon North station (future) materializes. Large liquid development and efficient layout are real pluses; flat resale appreciation and full launch pricing hold it to Neutral.
red_flags: Resale-only appreciation just 1.35%/yr — launch pricing inflates the 3.46% headline
950m from future MRT (CRL not yet operational)
2024 completion — recent launch pricing already in the asking price
catalysts: CR9 Serangoon North (Cross Island Line, ~2030) within ~1km
Large, liquid 513-txn development — strong exit depth
Efficient 560 sqft 1BR, sub-$900k entry in D19

history.summary: Genuinely cheap OCR 1BR with a verified, dated MRT catalyst. Asking $1,534 psf sits well below verified recent 1BR transactions of $1,793-$1,999 psf, and the Serangoon North CRL station (4-5 min walk, ~2030) is a hard, dated catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: The algo's cheapness is real and web-verified: this 560sqft 1BR asks $1,534 psf while recent (2025) 1BR transactions at the project printed $1,793-$1,999 psf and the project 12-mo average is ~$1,823 psf (project-wide range $1,455-$2,233). That is a ~15-20% discount to the actual 1BR cohort, not a thin-data quirk — appreciation_txns=513 and psf_cohort_txns=37 are deep. age_adj_premium -20.4% and psf_premium_vs_cohort -10.8% both corroborate. Region aligns with the v3.4 prior (OCR ≈ +4.0% realized forward, the best bracket). The catalyst is decisive: the Cross-Island Line Serangoon North station (CR9) is a confirmed ~4-5 min walk and targeted ~2030, and the project was cited as 'the most immediate beneficiary' of the CRL announcement. Build by Oxley/Lian Beng with Bosch/Grohe fittings; reasonable quality. The discount is the edge; the MRT is the kicker.
red_flags: 99-yr leasehold from 2024 — lease decay long-dated but not a forward edge
Asking is a notable discount to cohort — confirm the specific unit isn't a poor stack/low floor/west-facing that justifies the gap before committing
Large project (1,000+ units) — internal 1BR resale competition can cap upside
catalysts: Serangoon North MRT (Cross-Island Line CR9), ~4-5 min walk, targeted ~2030 — dated, confirmed connectivity catalyst
Within 1km of Rosyth School — supports owner-occupier/rental demand
OCR location aligns with v3.4 best-realized-forward-return bracket
